source: Our World in Data – CO₂ and Greenhouse Gas Emissions

metrics.title: CO₂ emissions per capita
metrics.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions from burning fossil fuels and industrial processes. This includes emissions from transport, electricity generation, and heating, but not land-use change.
metrics.source: Global Carbon Budget (2025) [https://globalcarbonbudget.org/]; Population based on various sources (2024) [https://ourworldindata.org/population-sources]

metrics.title: Annual CO₂ emissions
metrics.description: Annual total emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, measured in million tonnes.

metrics.title: Cumulative CO₂ emissions
metrics.description: Total cumulative emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, since the first year of available data, measured in million tonnes.

metrics.title: Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions
metrics.description: Total cumulative emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, since the first year of available data, measured as a percentage of global total cumulative emissions of CO₂.

metrics.title: Per capita consumption-based CO₂ emissions
metrics.description: Annual consumption-based emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), measured in tonnes per person.
metrics.source: Global Carbon Budget (2025) [https://globalcarbonbudget.org/]; Population based on various sources (2024) [https://ourworldindata.org/population-sources]

metrics.title: Population
metrics.description: Population by country, available from 10,000 BCE to 2100, based on data and estimates from different sources.

metrics.title: GDP per capita
metrics.description: Gross domestic product divided by population, adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries. Derived here from OWID's gdp and population columns.
metrics.source: Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database (via Our World in Data)
